name: shiftboard
description: In-house shift marketplace — post open shifts, let staff claim them, with automatic pay calculation and manager approvals.

scripts.build:vercel: node scripts/make-prod-schema.mjs && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.production.prisma && prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.production.prisma --skip-generate && next build
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: prisma db push && npm run db:seed && npm run icons
